items.description: PNA Southdowns is a branch of the PNA stationery and craft retail chain, trading from Shop 3 and 4 in Southdowns Shopping Centre, Irene, Centurion. PNA has operated in South Africa since 1992 and now runs more than 140 stores nationwide, selling stationery, school and office supplies, art and craft essentials and gift cards. Customers shopping through the chain's online store benefit from nationwide delivery and secure, popular payment methods, while purchases are covered by a 10-day return policy on merchandise, subject to terms and conditions. As part of the wider PNA network, the Southdowns store draws on the brand's established buying power and nationwide presence to offer a broad range of stationery, art, craft, school and office products to shoppers in the Southdowns and wider Irene area, backed by the chain's rewards programme and customer help centre support for queries.

PostNet Blaauw Village operates from Shop 005 in the Blaauw Village shopping centre on Ben Viljoen Street, Pretoria North, trading Monday to Friday from 08:00 to 18:00 and Saturday mornings from 08:00 to 13:00, closed on Sundays and public holidays. As part of the national PostNet network, the branch offers a range of domestic courier options, from PostNet2PostNet counter-to-counter delivery to PostNet2Door home and business deliveries at overnight, standard and economy speeds, together with international shipping through PostNet Global Express and DHL Express. Customers can also arrange Easy Global Mail forwarding, excess baggage shipping and optional Peace of Mind insurance cover on parcels. Beyond courier work, the store provides digital business services, including access to internet stations, credit report requests, email services and fax-to-email facilities, making it a convenient stop for both personal and small-business courier and digital needs in Pretoria North.

Based in Shop 7A of the Eastpark Centre on Baviaanspoort Road, PostNet East Lynne combines a copy-and-print counter with courier and stationery services for the East Lynne area. Its print services cover A4 and A3 document printing, wide-format and building-plan printing, business cards and photo printing, together with name badges and rubber stamps for businesses and individuals. The store also stocks convenience stationery and packaging material, and handles outgoing and incoming parcels through PostNet's courier network, plus website-building services for small businesses. The branch is open through the week from 08:00 to 18:00, on Saturdays from 09:00 to 14:00, and for shortened hours of 09:00 to 13:00 on public holidays, while remaining closed on Sundays. This mix of printing, stationery, courier and digital services positions the East Lynne store as a practical, local option for everyday business and personal document and parcel needs.

PostNet Hammanskraal trades from Shop A26C in the Renbro Shopping Centre on Old Warmbaths Road, serving the Hammanskraal area as part of the national PostNet network. In line with the wider PostNet offering, the branch provides courier services for sending and receiving parcels, document and photo printing, and a range of digital and small-business support solutions, alongside everyday stationery needs. The store keeps extended weekday hours, opening from 08:00 to 17:30 Monday to Friday, with shorter Saturday trading from 08:30 to 13:00, and stays closed on Sundays and public holidays. For residents and small businesses in and around Hammanskraal, the branch offers a local point of access to PostNet's national courier and printing network without needing to travel into central Pretoria for everyday copying, printing and parcel-sending needs.

PostNet Hennopspark operates from the Silver Creek Centre on Hendrik Verwoerd Drive in Centurion, opening earlier than many branches at 07:15 on weekdays and trading through to 17:00, with Saturday and public-holiday hours from 08:00 to 13:00 and Sundays closed. The store's print counter handles A4 and A3 printing, wide-format and building-plan printing, business cards and photo printing, as well as name badges and rubber stamps. Customers can also pick up convenience stationery and packaging material, send and collect parcels through PostNet's courier service, and arrange Vox-powered website packages for small businesses. The early weekday opening time makes the branch a practical stop for commuters and local businesses in Hennopspark needing printing, stationery or courier services before the standard business day begins elsewhere in the area.

At Shop 33 in the Waterglen Shopping Centre, on the corner of January Masilela Drive and Garstfontein Road in Waterkloof Glen, PostNet Menlyn offers printing, stationery and courier services to the surrounding Glenstantia and Waterkloof Glen area. Printing options at the counter include A4 and A3 documents, wide-format and building-plan prints, business cards and photographs, together with name badges and rubber stamps made to order. Shoppers can also buy everyday convenience stationery and packaging material, post or collect courier parcels, and sign up for a Vox-powered small-business website package. The branch trades Monday to Friday from 08:00 to 17:30 and on Saturdays from 08:30 to 13:00, closing on Sundays and public holidays, giving nearby households and businesses a full working week of access to its printing and courier counter.

PostNet Station Square occupies Shop 5 on the ground floor of the Station Square Shopping Centre, on the corner of Bosman and Jacob Mare Streets in Pretoria's city centre. The branch forms part of PostNet's national courier network, handling domestic deliveries through PostNet2PostNet and PostNet2Door services at various speeds, as well as international shipments via PostNet Global Express and DHL Express. Alongside parcel services, the store offers digital business facilities such as internet stations, credit report requests, email services and fax-to-email, giving city-centre workers and businesses a walk-in option for everyday digital and courier tasks. Trading hours run from 08:00 to 17:00 on weekdays and 09:00 to 13:00 on Saturdays, with the store closed on Sundays and public holidays, making it accessible to commuters and office workers in the Pretoria CBD during the working week.

PostNet Wonderpark trades from Shop 136B in the Wonderpark Shopping Centre, on the corner of Brits and Heinrich Avenue in Karen Park, and keeps some of the longer hours in the PostNet network: Monday to Friday from 08:00 to 18:00, Saturdays from 09:00 to 15:00, and Sundays and public holidays from 08:00 to 15:00. The branch's counter covers A4 and A3 printing, wide-format and building-plan printing, business cards and photo printing, plus name badges and rubber stamps produced on site. Customers can also buy convenience stationery and packaging material, and send or collect parcels through PostNet's courier service. With trading hours that extend into Sunday and public holidays, the Wonderpark branch gives shoppers in Karen Park and the wider Wonderpark catchment area a wider window than most PostNet stores for printing, stationery and courier needs.

items.description: Pretoria Aggregates & Plant Hire, based in Dorandia, supplies tractor-loader-backhoe (TLB) and tipper-truck hire to the construction trade, alongside building materials including sand, stone, maxi bricks, red bricks and paving bricks. The company positions itself as a single point of contact for construction logistics, combining machinery hire with material supply so that contractors and private builders can source equipment and materials from one supplier. Beyond hire and supply, the business also handles rubble removal and site clearance, helping manage a construction site from the early stages of groundwork through to clearing debris once building work is complete. Its service approach emphasises dependable machinery, consistent quality in the sand, stone and brick products it supplies, and project management aimed at keeping construction schedules on track. The combination of TLB and tipper-truck hire with bulk materials and site-clearance services makes it a practical supplier for small and medium building projects in and around Dorandia.

Most of the substantive text names individual staff members (excluded per instructions) and does not confirm the SACPVP credentials or 2011 founding date used in the current description. Not enough non-personal, valuation-specific content for a compliant description.

items.description: Pro-Namic Real Estate is a Magalieskruin-based property agency drawing on more than twenty years of experience in the Pretoria property market. For buyers, the agency has built a conversational property search tool, described as a 'Property Assistant', that lets house-hunters describe what they are looking for in everyday language rather than filling in rigid filters, returning current matches from Pro-Namic's own listings and allowing buyers to refine their search step by step without starting over. For sellers, the agency offers a free property valuation alongside hands-on guidance through the marketing and sale process, combining local market knowledge with negotiation experience built up over two decades in the area. The agency markets itself around the idea of understanding Pretoria property rather than simply listing it, aiming to match buyers with suitable homes and to guide sellers through pricing and marketing their properties with personal support throughout the transaction.

Profcor is an accounting firm based in The Willows, Pretoria, offering accounting, audit and assurance, payroll, tax and CIPC-related business services to local clients. Its team of chartered accountants and tax consultants handles day-to-day bookkeeping and accounting alongside statutory audit and assurance work, payroll processing, tax consulting and compliance, and company secretarial matters lodged with the Companies and Intellectual Property Commission. The firm presents its local knowledge of the Pretoria business environment and South Africa's financial and tax regulations as central to its approach, aiming to help Pretoria-based businesses stay compliant while planning for growth. Rather than positioning itself purely as a once-a-year tax preparer, Profcor describes its role as a continuing business partner, providing proactive advice on tax complexities and compliance questions as they arise throughout a client's financial year, alongside the standard accounting, audit, payroll and company-secretarial services it offers from its Willows office.

items.description: ProTours is a coach and bus charter operator based in Lyttelton, Centurion, established in 2020 with the aim of supporting South Africa's tourism sector through the recovery that followed the coronavirus pandemic. While its core focus remains tourism transport, the company has also built partnerships with corporate, educational and private clients needing group transport. Its team brings a combined 25 years of experience in the transport industry, operating a fleet of coaches and minibuses that the company says has been adapted to local conditions while meeting international standards. ProTours is a Level 1 BBBEE contributor and describes itself as a 100% women-owned coach operator, positioning it within South Africa's broader transformation and tourism-recovery efforts. The business aims to simplify the charter process from initial booking through to the completed journey, serving clients who need reliable group transport for tourism, corporate events or educational outings based out of its Lyttelton Manor premises.

items.description: Reach Out Financial Services, based in Alphen Park, provides a broad range of accounting, tax, payroll, secretarial and trust-related services to its clients. On the accounting side, the firm offers both basic monthly bookkeeping with VAT and other statutory returns and more comprehensive monthly accounting and financial planning. Its audit division carries out statutory audits, MIDP claims, internal-controls assessments and business valuations, while its tax team handles tax planning, the preparation of returns, tax clearances and tax directives. For employers, Reach Out runs payroll functions including monthly payroll reports, payslips, interim and annual SARS reconciliations and IRP5 certificates. The firm's secretarial arm forms companies and close corporations, including shelf companies, and manages the statutory returns and VAT, PAYE and UIF registrations that follow, together with CIPC filings. A separate trust and legal service structures personal estates through trusts for wealth protection, acts as independent trustee, reviews trust deeds, and compiles and reviews wills for clients seeking estate-planning support.

RE/MAX Infoglobe's Constantia office opened in February 2009 and specialises in the sale and rental of residential and commercial property across Pretoria East, Centurion and the Western Cape Winelands region. The office trades under the global RE/MAX brand, which was founded in 1973 and entered the South African market in 1995; RE/MAX Infoglobe itself has been recognised among South Africa's Top 300 companies since 2002. As part of the wider RE/MAX network, the Constantia branch draws on a franchise system of more than 160 offices across South Africa and upwards of 3,500 real estate professionals nationally, with RE/MAX operating in over 100 countries worldwide. The office's property listings are marketed through RE/MAX's own property portal as well as linked third-party property sites, giving sellers in its Pretoria East and Centurion coverage area access to a national referral network built up over several decades of the franchise's operation in the local market.

RenuSec (Pty) Ltd, operating from a warehouse base at Plot 75 in Rietfontein, Rayton, describes itself as a provider of sustainable energy and security solutions for the wider Pretoria area. The business works on a by-appointment basis from its warehouse premises, rather than a walk-in retail front, and keeps standard weekday business hours from 07:00 to 16:00, Monday to Friday, closing over weekends and public holidays. Its focus spans two related fields: renewable-energy installations such as solar power and inverter systems, and security-related services, reflecting the pairing of energy resilience and property security that many Gauteng homeowners and businesses are increasingly looking to combine. Clients wanting a consultation or quotation are directed to contact RenuSec's sales team directly rather than visiting on spec, consistent with the appointment-only nature of its Rietfontein operation. The company markets itself on responsiveness and clear communication with clients throughout installation projects.

Retail Star, based in Raslouw, Centurion, supplies retail stores with trained merchandising and replenishment staff who manage shelf stocking, planogram compliance and general in-store stock levels on behalf of client brands. The company trains its own field staff through a hands-on, open-door coaching and mentorship approach rather than simply placing temporary labour, and backs this with supporting technology and dedicated operations and logistics management to keep store coverage consistent. New prospective clients are offered a free audit of their current retail operations as a way of identifying where staffing, stock replenishment or in-store presentation could be improved before any contract begins. Retail Star traces its roots to a background spanning retail operations, logistics, sales and hygiene services, and positions its ongoing investment in staff training and retention as the foundation of the store standards it aims to deliver for its retail clients.

RIB Software is a construction and building information modelling (BIM) software provider with a branch in Irene, Centurion, forming part of a group that was founded in Stuttgart, Germany, in 1961. The company builds software used across the architecture, engineering and construction industry, and became a subsidiary of the French multinational Schneider Electric in 2020. Globally, RIB Software operates more than 20 branches across the EMEA, APAC and North America regions, and employed around 2,600 people as of 2024. Its Irene office gives the group a local base from which to support construction and engineering clients in the Centurion and wider Pretoria area with BIM and related construction-management software, drawing on more than six decades of product development history and the backing of a major international industrial group through its Schneider Electric ownership.

Ridge Surface Treatments CC and Ridge Powder Coating CC operate as part of a general engineering business based in Sunderland Ridge, Centurion, founded in 1991. The company manufactures and repairs machined parts to customer drawings and specifications, working with both ferrous and non-ferrous steels as well as engineering plastics, and specialises in CNC milling and turning for both production runs and individual once-off components. Alongside its machining work, the business offers an integrated range of surface-finishing services, including powder coating in a variety of colours, powder coating over galvanised surfaces, sandblasting and bead blasting, hot-dip galvanizing, and zinc, blue, yellow or black plating. Further finishing options cover chemical blackening, natural and dye or hard anodizing, electroless nickel plating, gun coating and allodizing. The business also provides project control for related fabrication, casting, pressing and forging work, plus specialised welding and laser, water-jet, gas-profile and plasma-profile cutting services for engineering clients needing a finished, treated component rather than raw machined parts.

RifleSURE is a specialist insurer based in Willow Park Manor that focuses exclusively on cover for firearm owners rather than offering firearms insurance as one line within a general policy. Its policies are designed to protect not just rifles, handguns, shotguns and bows, but also the optics and accessories that go with them, including rifle scopes, binoculars, rangefinders and chronographs, as well as collectable firearms and reloading equipment. Cover options include up to R10 million in public liability protection, worldwide protection for firearms taken abroad, and legal defence assistance, with clients able to choose between five package tiers, named Core, Plus, Premium, Signature and Platinum, offering different levels of cover. RifleSURE markets its claims process as fast and efficient compared with conventional insurers, positioning itself specifically for South African hunters, sport shooters, collectors and firearm owners who need cover tailored to the particular risks of owning and travelling with firearms and related equipment.

items.reason: Research returned only a raw list of addresses for other RocoMamas branches across Gauteng (Bedfordview, Bel Air, Blueberry Square, Boksburg, Brooklyn Mall, etc.); no menu, feature or setting information specific to the Irene Village Mall branch itself was found. Not enough branch-specific content for a genuine description.

items.description: Rossfurn is a wholesale furniture manufacturer based in Klerksoord, Akasia, producing engineered wood furniture for the trade rather than selling directly to the public. The company operates on a wholesale-only basis, meaning its catalogue and pricing are reserved for registered furniture retailers rather than individual household buyers, who must apply for a trade account before they can place orders. By manufacturing in-house rather than importing finished stock, Rossfurn positions itself as a supplier that retailers can turn to for engineered wood furniture ranges at trade pricing, with the option for prospective retail partners to request a visit to view the catalogue before applying for an account. This business-to-business model distinguishes it from typical furniture showrooms, focusing instead on supplying the retail furniture trade across the areas it serves from its Klerksoord manufacturing base.

Samrand Plumber Inc is a 24-hour emergency plumbing service covering Samrand, Centurion, Pretoria East, Midrand, Irene and Rooihuiskraal. Its core emergency work centres on burst geyser repairs and replacements, blocked drains and sewer lines, and leak detection and repair, alongside everyday tap, toilet and pipe repair and replacement work. The business also carries out bathroom renovations and kitchen plumbing, geyser installations and conversions to solar geysers, and general drain cleaning. It advertises a same-day response for call-outs and does not charge a separate call-out fee, positioning itself for households and businesses dealing with urgent plumbing problems outside normal office hours as well as planned renovation work. Describing itself as a local plumber for the Samrand area rather than a call-centre-dispatched national brand, the company presents round-the-clock availability as the basis for its emergency and renovation plumbing service across its Centurion and Pretoria East coverage area.

Sebenzela Security Solutions (Pty) Ltd, based in Moregloed, traces its origins to 2008, when the idea of bringing security solutions to South African communities led to the registration of Xplicit Trading, trading as XT Systems, initially focused on supplying and installing security equipment before expanding into guarding services. In 2021, a dedicated guarding-services business was registered as Sebenzela Security Solutions (Pty) Ltd, aiming to become a leading contract security provider across the property, corporate, industrial, commercial, residential and construction sectors. The company is a registered service provider with the Private Security Industry Regulatory Authority, and operates from its Pretoria head office with a business model covering clients nationally. Its service range includes manned guarding, the installation of CCTV, intrusion detection, access control, biometric systems, electric fencing and automated gates, as well as control-room monitoring with armed response, the provision of trained dog handlers and security dogs, and the supply of security-related equipment to its clients.

Sheet Street Gezina trades from Shop 4 in the Gezina Galleries, on the corner of Michael Brink and Frederika Streets, open Monday to Friday from 08:00 to 18:00, Saturdays from 08:00 to 16:00 and Sundays from 08:00 to 14:00. The branch is part of the Sheet Street home-décor chain, which describes itself as more than three decades into its history of selling affordable bedroom, living-room, bathroom and kitchen textiles and homeware, operating through a network of some 320 stores alongside its online shop. The chain positions affordability as central to its identity, aiming to let customers furnish and decorate their homes without paying premium prices, while also highlighting efforts to reduce its environmental footprint, including cutting plastic packaging in its stores and using recycled plastic fibres in some of its bedding ranges. The Gezina branch gives shoppers in the area local access to this national homeware range during its daily trading hours.

Shield Express Car Wash Hazeldean Square is a branch of the Shield Express car-care chain, which operates nine locations across Gauteng offering vehicle cleaning and detailing services. The branch at Hazeldean Square trades seven days a week, from 08:00 to 17:00 daily, giving customers in the Tijgervallei and wider Hazeldean area a consistent window for washing and detailing their vehicles without needing to book around weekday-only hours. As part of a chain rather than an independent operator, the Hazeldean Square branch follows Shield Express's standard car-wash and detailing service menu, and the brand also offers franchise opportunities to operators interested in opening further locations under the same name. The seven-day trading hours make the Hazeldean branch a convenient stop for both routine washes and more thorough detailing work for vehicle owners passing through or living near the Hazeldean Square area.

Shumani Optimal Holdings, based in Monavoni, is a digital company building mobile apps, websites and branding for clients as well as its own line of consumer apps. On the development side, it offers Android app development, Flutter-based cross-platform development, mobile game development, UI/UX design and Google Play publishing support, alongside business websites, ecommerce stores, landing pages, portfolio websites and ongoing website maintenance for clients, plus logo design, brand identity work, social media graphics and marketing material design. The company also develops and publishes its own mobile apps on Google Play, including Mini Mind Quest, a brain-training and problem-solving puzzle game; Wordrift Quest, a word-search and vocabulary puzzle game; Snap Total, a grocery cost-calculator utility app for estimating shopping totals; and Global Quest Trivia, a multi-category trivia and knowledge game. Some of these in-house apps are supported by branded merchandise, such as a Mini Mind Quest hoodie and a Wordrift Quest T-shirt, extending the company's digital products into physical branded items.

Signarama Pretoria Central, based at Scientia Techno Park in Brummeria, designs, manufactures and installs signage and branding for businesses across Pretoria. Rather than acting purely as a signage supplier, the franchise frames its service around understanding a client's business and branding needs before developing a signage solution, managing projects from initial concept through to on-site installation. Its product range covers shop and building signage, illuminated signs, vehicle signage, wayfinding and promotional signs, indoor and outdoor signs, wall signage, bakkie signage and exhibition displays, serving retail, medical, education and industrial clients among others. The branch trades Monday to Thursday from 08:30 to 17:00 and Fridays from 08:30 to 16:00, giving local businesses a weekday window to discuss signage requirements, request quotes and arrange installation. As part of the wider Signarama franchise network, the Pretoria Central store draws on standardised signage categories and an installation-through-to-finish process used across the brand's branches.

Signarama Pretoria East, located on Wekker Road in Moreleta Park, provides signage design, manufacture and installation for businesses in Pretoria East. The branch says its signage range covers everything from window decals to LED signs, and it offers project management of signage installations to help keep multi-sign rollouts consistent and on schedule. Product categories include shop signage, illuminated signs, vehicle signage, wayfinding and promotional signage, indoor and outdoor signs, wall signage, bakkie signage, building signage and exhibition displays, aimed at franchises, retail, medical and corporate clients. Trading hours run Monday to Thursday from 07:30 to 16:30 and Fridays from 07:30 to 16:00. As part of the Signarama franchise network, the Pretoria East branch follows the brand's end-to-end approach of taking a signage project from initial concept through design and manufacture to on-site installation, aiming to deliver consistent, durable signage for its Pretoria East client base.

items.description: Sithagu Architects sells ready-made residential house plans online, covering styles from Tuscan and Scotch designs to butterfly-roofed houses, roundavels, farm-style homes and small cottage plans, in configurations ranging from one-bedroom to seven-bedroom and double-storey layouts, including options with concrete flat roofs or IBR flat roofs. Individual plans are sold at set prices, with examples including a five-bedroom rural-area design offered at a reduced R7,500 (down from R13,000), a one-bedroom rural-area plan at R2,000 (down from R2,500), and a four-bedroom rural-area design at R16,000 (down from R18,000). Typical plan features described alongside the designs include double garages, open-plan lounge, kitchen and dining areas, covered patios with built-in braai space, and multiple bedroom suites with en-suite bathrooms in the larger plans. Rather than offering architectural design-from-scratch services, the business operates as a catalogue seller of pre-drawn house plans in a range of styles and sizes, aimed at buyers in Pretoria North and the wider Akasia area looking for ready-to-build residential designs at fixed prices.

items.description: Snyman de Jager Attorneys was established in 1938 and now operates four branches across Gauteng and the Western Cape, including its Centurion office at River Falls Office Park in Doringkloof. The firm practises across four main areas: property and conveyancing, covering transfers, bonds and registrations from offer to final registration; litigation; estates, wills and trusts; and notarial and general legal practice, including contracts and notarial deeds. The firm markets its long operating history and four-branch structure as giving clients access to experienced attorneys in Centurion, Menlyn, Midstream and Stellenbosch, while aiming to keep a single, personal point of contact for each client's matter from the first consultation through to final registration or resolution. The Centurion branch handles property, conveyancing, litigation, estate administration and notarial work for clients in the Centurion and wider Pretoria area under this long-established firm's name.

South Zambezi Engineering Services (Pty) Ltd is a multidisciplinary consulting firm based in Kosmosdal, Centurion, offering engineering, planning and project-management services under one practice. Its service lines include civil engineering, quantity surveying, project management, town and regional planning, road design, architectural and draughting services, electrical and mechanical engineering, municipal services and GIS (geographic information system) solutions. By combining these disciplines in a single firm, South Zambezi positions itself to take on projects that need coordination across several technical fields, such as infrastructure and roads work that also requires planning input, surveying and project oversight, rather than clients having to appoint separate specialists for each discipline. The firm describes engineering as central to its identity rather than simply one service among many, and markets its multidisciplinary structure as a way of offering coordinated technical and planning support to construction and infrastructure clients from its Kosmosdal base.

SPAR Barclay Square is an independently owned supermarket trading inside the Barclay Square Shopping Centre in Sunnyside under the SPAR brand, which began operating in South Africa in 1963 when a group of eight wholesalers formed a network of independent retailers. SPAR has since grown into a national network of more than 2,500 independently owned stores supplied through a system of distribution centres, while individual stores like Barclay Square remain locally owned and run rather than centrally managed outlets. Shoppers can choose from more than 1,000 exclusive SPAR-brand products, which carry the chain's 'Double Your Money Back Quality Guarantee', alongside other grocery, fresh-produce and household lines. The Barclay Square store trades daily from 07:00 to 21:00, giving Sunnyside residents extended seven-day access to groceries and SPAR's own-brand range as part of a retail model the group describes as more than six decades old in South Africa.

Spif Chicken Zambezi Junction is a retail outlet of the Spif Chicken poultry brand, which has its roots in the Waterberg region of Limpopo Province and has been producing chicken for more than three decades. The name 'Spif' comes from colloquial slang for something good, and the business has grown from its original poultry farming operation into a diversified agri-business with separate broiler-chicken, beef, cropping, piggery and wildlife divisions, while its core focus remains raising, processing and distributing farm broiler chickens. The company markets its chicken products as 0% brine-injected, distinguishing them from brine-injected alternatives sold elsewhere, and distributes them through a network of 17 outlets spread across Gauteng, Limpopo and Mpumalanga, of which the Zambezi Junction store in Montana Park is one. The outlet gives shoppers in the area access to chicken supplied directly from the company's own farming and processing operations rather than through a separate third-party retail wholesaler.

Stabilis Treatment Centre, based in Moregloed, has provided residential and outpatient care for substance dependency for more than 50 years. The centre describes its approach as combining medical care, counselling and spiritual guidance within a framework of Christian values, aiming to treat addiction through a multi-disciplinary team of medical, psychological and therapeutic professionals rather than counselling alone. Its core programmes include a supervised Detoxification Programme, providing medically managed withdrawal and stabilisation for patients beginning treatment; an In-Patient Rehabilitation programme, an integrated therapeutic course addressing the physical, psychological and behavioural aspects of addiction; and an Out-Patient Programme offering structured therapy and monitoring for people who need to continue working or studying while being treated. The centre positions its decades of operating history and faith-based, multi-disciplinary model as central to how it supports patients and their families through alcohol, medication and drug dependence, from initial detoxification through to longer-term rehabilitation and after-care support in Moregloed.

Stoep Restaurant operates inside Candlewoods Country Estate in Centurion as a family-oriented restaurant built around wood-fired pizza alongside a wider menu of mains, breakfasts, salads and desserts. Beyond regular sit-down dining, the restaurant hosts functions and private events such as birthdays, baby or bridal showers, corporate gatherings and other celebrations, and runs a 'Stoep Supper Club' offering prepared meals for collection or delivery rather than only in-restaurant dining. It also hosts 'Rugby on the Stoep' screenings for major games, positioning itself as a social gathering spot on match days as well as a restaurant. Breakfast is served from Friday to Sunday, while the kitchen is closed on Mondays and otherwise trades through the week and over weekends. Set within the Candlewoods Country Estate grounds, the restaurant markets itself less as a standalone eatery and more as a gathering place for the surrounding community, built around long lunches, wood-fired pizza and shared meals.

Stone Sensation, based in Silverton, supplies paving, cladding and decorative stone products for residential and commercial projects, delivering to customers across Gauteng and beyond. Its product range covers pool and patio paving tiles, commercial paving, driveway paving and simulated paving, along with wall cladding and floor and roof tiles for building projects. For gardens, the company also supplies landscaping stones, garden rocks and pebbles, custom stonework and garden décor pieces. The business markets its paving, tiling and cladding products as eco-friendly and durable, positioning itself to serve architects, landscapers and homeowners who need stone and paving materials for anything from a backyard patio to larger commercial paving and cladding projects. By covering both structural paving products and decorative garden stone in one supplier, Stone Sensation aims to serve both the building and landscaping sides of outdoor paving and cladding projects from its Silverton base.

Stormcote Waterproofing, based in Wingate Park, provides roof waterproofing and damp-proofing services for residential and commercial properties across Gauteng. The business works across different roof types, including IBR and other metal-sheet roofing, tiled roofs and concrete slab roofs, and offers a free roof inspection and quote before any work begins. Its process runs in three steps: an initial contact and free inspection, a detailed written quote for the waterproofing work required, and completion of the job with a signed guarantee provided to the client. The company also offers flexible financing options for customers who want to spread the cost of waterproofing work rather than paying the full amount upfront. By combining a free-quote process with a written guarantee on completed work, Stormcote positions itself for homeowners and commercial property owners dealing with roof leaks who want cost certainty and a documented guarantee before committing to waterproofing repairs.

Suntinco, based in Florauna, has specialised in window tinting, smash-and-grab protective film and blinds since 2005, serving Johannesburg, Pretoria, Rustenburg and Witbank. Applied to vehicles, homes and commercial buildings, the company's window film is marketed on several grounds: reducing solar heat gain and air-conditioning costs in summer while providing an additional thermal shield that can lower heating bills in winter, with tinting said to reduce heat transfer by up to 78% compared with untreated glass. The film is also presented as cutting glare and evening out 'hot wall' and 'cold wall' temperature differences within a room, and as blocking up to 99% of ultraviolet rays, which the company says reduces fading of furniture, carpets and store displays caused by UV exposure, as well as lowering UV-related health risks such as skin cancer. On the security side, Suntinco positions its smash-and-grab film as a deterrent that makes it harder for burglars to break through tinted windows to access vehicles or buildings, alongside its separate blinds product line for homes and offices.

items.description: Supreme Hygiene, based in Hennopspark, distributes hygiene equipment and cleaning supplies to businesses, offering products for rental, outright purchase or ongoing service and maintenance. Its catalogue spans several categories: hygiene equipment such as dispensers, hygiene consumables including air-mist refills, batteries, paper products, refuse bags, seat sanitisers, soap refills, toilet paper and urinal mats, general cleaning equipment such as brooms, cleaning chemicals, and a smaller pest-control product range. Within its equipment line, the company markets a 'Ticra' range of hygiene dispensers and fittings described as a more modern and elegant option with premium finishes, aimed at businesses wanting a higher-end look for washrooms and common areas. Rather than selling only outright, Supreme Hygiene offers monthly rental packages on its hygiene equipment, letting business customers access dispensers and related fittings without the upfront cost of buying them, while still being able to purchase cleaning chemicals, consumables and pest-control products as needed to support day-to-day cleaning and hygiene operations.
